scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Welcome to Izlude,
Prontera's satellite city.
If you need any guidance
around Izlude, feel free
to ask me at anytime.
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
欢迎来到依斯鲁得，
普隆德拉的卫星城市。
如果您需要关于依斯鲁得的指引，
请随时向我提问。

scripts.text: City Guide
scripts.translation: 城市向导

the following menu.
[Izlude Guide]

is located on an island that is
in west Izlude. If you're thinking of changing jobs to Swordman,
you should check it out.

如果您打算转职为剑士，
不妨去看看。

scripts.text:

[依斯鲁得向导]

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]

a location from
the following menu.
[Izlude Guide]
You can find the
Marina in the northeast

ride a ship which will take you

在那里，您可以乘坐船只前往艾尔贝塔或拜兰岛。

[Izlude Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.

如果您不希望小地图上显示位置标记，
请告诉我“移除小地图标记”。

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Advances in sorcery and
technology have allowed
us to update our information
system, enabling up to mark
locations on your Mini-Map
for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
魔法与科技的进步使我们得以更新资讯系统，
现在您可以在小地图上标记位置，以便更轻松地导航。

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
小地图位于屏幕的右上角。
如果您看不到它，请按 Ctrl + Tab 键，
或点击基本资讯窗口中的“地图”按钮。

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in the city of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
在小地图上，点击“+”和“-”符号可以放大或缩小地图。
祝您在依斯鲁得城旅行愉快。

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Okay then, feel
free to come to me
if you ever feel lost
around Izlude, alright?
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
好的，如果您在依斯鲁得迷路了，
随时可以来找我，好吗？
